# 0.3.3

This release adds project-directory reporting consent and expands the local
console's source record, budget and policy views.

## Directory reporting consent

- `commonmeasure enrol` selects a canonical project directory for local
  recording or reporting to the configured Hub. Reporting includes existing
  eligible evidence only after explicit acknowledgement.
- Managed reporting requires owner approval and a signed grant for that edge
  and directory. Grants expire within 24 hours; a failed refresh never extends
  them. Source policy and confidential scopes can still withhold reporting.
- Related Git worktrees require separate consent. Local-only ancestors veto
  reporting from nested repositories. Queued batches are checked again before
  delivery, including after revocation or loss of the consent registry.
- Claude Code gains `/commonmeasure:enrol`; `install codex` installs the
  `commonmeasure-enrol` skill. The MCP server exposes `context_enrol` and an
  enrolment prompt. Interactive host invocation remains unverified.

## Console and documentation

- The Budget screen shows recorded context footprints, declared caps and
  principal allowance standing.
- Source-record details show the evidence carried by a crossing, including
  content hashes, source declarations, manifest discovery, reporting decisions
  and allowance settlement where those facts were recorded.
- Policy forecasts, provider status and comparison results share the same
  projections across the console and JSON API. Console writes return JSON
  when requested, with the same validation and revision checks as the forms.
- Expanded guides explain context-window optimisation and untrusted context.

## Upgrade and verification limits

Upgrade every binary sharing an operator home before using directory
selection. Older binaries do not enforce the new consent registry; mixed
old/new enforcement is unsupported. Rerun `install codex` to install the new
skill, or update the Claude plugin to obtain its enrolment command.

Managed directory approval needs the matching Hub implementation. Local
real-Hub integration covers approval, withholding, delivery, revocation and
expiry. Hosted first-delivery and managed-policy acceptance remain open, as
does the operator's assessment of the record.

The effective-policy resolver version advances to 2. Existing signed policy
payloads and their document digests remain unchanged.

Directory enrolment is unavailable on Windows because an authenticated
OS-user basis is not implemented there. The Windows installer remains
unverified. Host coverage and its evidence grades are listed in
`docs/contracts/host-integration.md`. Sealed demonstration runs under
`demo/output/` retain their recording-machine paths.
